statement.zh: Woolley《乌尔发掘》VI（1974）报告乌尔三朝建筑（除塔庙外），含杜吉/布尔辛陵、城墙与乌尔纳姆石碑。
statement.en: Woolley UE VI (1974) reports Ur III buildings at Ur other than the ziggurat, including Dungi/Bur-Sin mausolea, city wall, and the Stela of Ur-Nammu.

editorial.notes: Density pass 4; contested material kept as hypothesis where applicable.
